risks.risk: Generator may not be functional or may have internal damage (e.g., worn engine, faulty starter, or damaged windings).
risks.proof: A video showing the generator starting and running, with sound and output voltage measured on a multimeter.

risks.risk: The '100% copper' claim may be false; the generator may use aluminum windings, which are cheaper and less efficient.
risks.proof: A close-up photo or video of the stator windings or a professional inspection report.
risks.if_unproven: priced as aluminum-wound, which reduces value

risks.risk: The key starter may not work or may be missing; the photos do not show the starter mechanism.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the key starter switch and a video showing it in operation.
risks.if_unproven: priced as manual pull-start only, which reduces value

risks.risk: Fuel tank or engine may have leaks or corrosion not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the fuel tank, engine base, and exhaust area, ideally with the generator running.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially leaking or corroded

proof_requests: Video of the generator starting and running with sound and output voltage check.
Close-up photo of the key starter switch and control panel.
Close-up photo of the engine and fuel tank area to check for leaks or corrosion.
Photo or video of the stator windings to verify '100% copper' claim.
